children: UK broadcast automation software firm's H1 revenue rose 10% year-on-year
Adjusted EPS for H1 nearly doubled, with adjusted profit before tax up 73%
Profit growth driven by timing of high-margin software licence sales
Pebble expects to achieve a net cash position by end-2026
Company expects software licence revenue to be a lower proportion in H2, normalising EBITDA margins
Pebble says it is well-positioned to meet full-year forecasts, supported by a strong order book
SOFTWARE LICENCE SALES - Co said profit growth benefited from favourable timing of high-margin software licence deliveries
RECURRING REVENUE - Recurring revenue rose 6% year-on-year, supported by strong renewal levels and contract expansions
NEW CUSTOMER WINS - Four major new customers signed, including streaming and traditional broadcasters, contributed to order growth
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Pebble Beach Systems Group PLC is GBp34.00, about 30.8% above its September 8 closing price of GBp26.00
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 12 three months ago
